name: RLOO + signed log compression + dampened whiten
tagline: Leave-one-out group baseline, signed-log soft-rank compression, then partially-centered token whitening.
formula: $$A_i = R_i - \tfrac{1}{n-1}\!\!\sum_{j\neq i}R_j,\;\; \tilde A_i = \mathrm{sign}(A_i)\,\tfrac{\log(1+\beta|A_i|)}{\log(1+\beta)}$$ $$\hat A_t = \frac{\tilde A - c\,\bar{\tilde A}}{\sqrt{\overline{(\tilde A - c\,\bar{\tilde A})^2}+\epsilon}}\cdot m_t,\;\;\bar\cdot=\mathrm{maskedMean}_m$$

key_hyperparams.name: center_damp c
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of mean subtracted before normalization

init_recovers: GRPO-like centering at beta=0 and c=1
diff_from_baseline: Replaces GRPO's group-mean baseline with the leave-one-out mean (lower variance), passes the result through a signed log1p compression, broadcasts to tokens, and finishes with a partially-centered (c=0.7) variance normalization instead of REINFORCE++-baseline's full masked_whiten.

name: Two-level KL-scaled group advantage
tagline: Dr.GRPO group centering then per-response and per-token soft-trust-region scaling by clipped pi_old/pi_ref KL, finished with token whitening.
diff_from_baseline: Dr.GRPO-style group-mean centering, then a multiplicative two-level penalty: (1+beta*KL_seq)^-1 * (1+alpha*KL_token)^-1 where KL is the clipped forward KL between old and ref log-probs; advantages are then masked_whitened across the batch.

name: SW-GRPO: surprisal-weighted GRPO
tagline: GRPO outcome advantages redistributed across tokens by 1 - exp(log_p) surprisal, normalized so the per-sequence weight averages to 1.
formula: $$\mathrm{adv}_i = \frac{R_i - \bar R_g}{\sigma_g + \epsilon},\quad s_t = 1-\exp(\min(0,\log\pi(a_t)))$$ $$w_{i,t} = \frac{(s_t + b_0)\,m_{i,t}}{\tfrac{1}{|m_i|}\sum_t (s_t+b_0)\,m_{i,t}+\epsilon},\quad A_{i,t}=\mathrm{adv}_i\cdot w_{i,t}\cdot m_{i,t}$$
init_recovers: GRPO when surprisal weights are uniform (s_t -> 0 with b0>0)
diff_from_baseline: Same GRPO outcome advantage as the grpo baseline, but instead of broadcasting it uniformly across the response, multiplies each token by a surprisal weight w_t derived from ref_log_probs (or old_log_probs), normalized per-sequence to mean 1; tokens predictable under the reference get less, surprising tokens get more.

name: RLOO + adaptive std blend + token whiten
tagline: Leave-one-out residual rescaled by an interpolation between Dr.GRPO and GRPO normalization (sigmoid in group std), then masked-whitened across tokens.
init_recovers: Dr.GRPO when group std -> 0; GRPO LOO when group std large
diff_from_baseline: Adopts the leave-one-out baseline like RLOO, then divides by an adaptive scale (1-rho)+rho*sigma where rho smoothly turns on std normalization only when within-group dispersion is large; per-group recentering removes drift, then REINFORCE++-baseline-style masked_whiten is applied across tokens. Returns the raw outcome (un-normalized) instead of advantages.

name: RANK-GRPO: rank + difficulty + sparse blend
tagline: Per-group rank advantage (rescaled to [-0.5, 0.5]) blended with z-score deviation, scaled by inverse success rate, then token-whitened.

key_hyperparams.name: sparsity threshold
key_hyperparams.role: switch between rank vs z-score advantage

init_recovers: Token-whitened GRPO when rank branch is off
diff_from_baseline: Replaces GRPO's z-scored mean-shifted reward with a per-group rank advantage rescaled to [-0.5, 0.5], hard-switched to the GRPO z-score whenever the group std exceeds 0.3; the chosen advantage is multiplied by an inverse-success-rate difficulty factor in [1, 4] and then masked-whitened across tokens (REINFORCE++-baseline-style).
